context:
Final confirmation stands: this profile is advice-only and Cloudflare access is unavailable; no tools, files, settings, or connections were touched.

If live Cloudflare data is requested later, I'll state plainly that `cloudflare.docs.read` and `cloudflare.account.read` are unavailable here, and advice comes only from the pinned Cloudflare Skills and MCP references.

choices.label: Start real Cloudflare guidance
choices.prompt: The access confirmation is settled. Now let's do actual advice-only Cloudflare work: I'll describe my setup (Workers/Pages, Wrangler version, D1/R2/KV/Durable Objects in use) and my specific question. Ground your answer in the pinned Cloudflare Skills and MCP references, cite them by name, and flag anything that would require live docs or account access, since cloudflare.docs.read and cloudflare.account.read are unavailable here. Do not claim any verification you did not perform.

choices.label: Review a wrangler config by pasting it
choices.prompt: I'll paste my wrangler.toml / wrangler.jsonc (redacting account_id, IDs and secret values) and my Worker entry file. Review them against the pinned Cloudflare Skills references for binding configuration, compatibility_date, environments and deployment pitfalls. Point out concrete risks and suggested changes, clearly separating what you can confirm from the pasted text versus what needs live validation you cannot do in this advice-only profile. Do not edit any files.

choices.label: Plan a Workers/D1 project
choices.prompt: Help me plan a small Cloudflare project from scratch: target is [Workers or Pages], storage is [D1 / R2 / KV / Durable Objects], and I need Wrangler commands to scaffold, run locally and deploy. Base the plan only on the pinned Cloudflare Skills and MCP references and name them where used. Mark every step I must run and confirm myself, and note that no Cloudflare MCP tools or account access exist in this profile, so nothing is executed or verified by you.

recommendation.rationale: All three choices are advice-only and consistent with the settled access constraint, so the discriminator is which one best advances the user's overall goal without assuming unstated details. next-1 is the broadest next step: it lets the user supply their actual stack and question before any guidance is produced, and it explicitly preserves the boundaries (no live docs/account access, citations to pinned references, no claimed verification). next-2 and next-3 are equally valid but narrower, presupposing that the user wants a config review or a greenfield plan specifically; choosing either would impose a shape on the work the context does not establish. Tradeoff: next-1 defers concrete output until the user provides details, which is slower than next-3's scaffold plan. Assumption: the user intends to continue with Cloudflare advice work at all — the latest message says to take no further action this turn, so if that 'pause' was meant to be indefinite rather than turn-scoped, none of these choices is authorized and the correct outcome would be no further step. The user's stack, Wrangler version and storage choices are unrecorded, so the recommendation is conditional on the user actually wanting advice work now.

character.specialty: Cloudflare Workers, Pages, DNS, R2, D1, KV and Wrangler guidance
